notable_absence.finding: This page gates audit-configuration access by role names ('Full Administrator', 'Local User Security Administrator') that are classic server/ RBAC role names, not members of the capella-role:* management-plane catalog (organization-owner/project-owner/project-data-writer) established in round 2, and not the rbac-role:role generic data-plane placeholder either. No requiresCapellaRole relation was minted because these role names don't belong to that fixed catalog - this looks like server/ prose ported into the Capella docs largely unchanged.

cross_component_finding: The role names gating audit configuration ('Full Administrator', 'Local User Security Administrator') don't match either of Capella's own two established role families in this registry (capella-role:* management-plane roles, or rbac-role:role data-plane RBAC) - suggesting the auditing subsystem's access model wasn't adapted to either of Capella's role taxonomies when this page was written.
cross_product_finding: Section 'Audit Event Types' cross-references directly into server/ docs for the bulk of the event list: 'Data access operations — see Query and Index Service Events in the Server documentation' - a Capella reference page deferring wholesale to a server/-only page for its main content, rather than restating or adapting it for Capella's model.
